C0.loc: Abstract, p. 412; Section 1 Introduction, p. 412; Section 2 Preliminaries, p. 413
C0.quote: Knockout tournaments constitute a popular format
C0.note: The paper studies fixing brackets of knockout (single-elimination) sports tournaments, where a tournament graph gives the outcomes of pairwise matches between players. No agents submit inputs (ballots, votes, preferences) that are aggregated by voting; voters and voting are never mentioned. Its object is tournament/bracket design for sports competitions, not a voting procedure, so it is coded INELIG and coding stops here.
